proposed_candidate.name: CPL
proposed_candidate.reason: The exact museum CPL anchor gives the joint designers’ August 1963 paper and January 1966 Cambridge manual as CPL documents. The distinct 1968 CPL1 paper identifies its London Atlas subset explicitly.

decisions.scope: Supports the historical language CPL as described in 1963. The separate CPL1 subset and compiler, Cambridge and London implementations, and features from later draft revisions need their own scope.

proposed_candidate.reason: The exact candidate URI serves the June 24, 2026 guide authored by Martin Richards. The guide’s opening identifies the language and separately treats two systems. decisions.name: B

proposed_candidate.name: B
proposed_candidate.reason: The pinned Linguist B row carries language ID 700792152, separate from B (Formal Method). The scoped .b heuristic and three exact specimen Git blobs use B’s characteristic auto, extrn, goto and function syntax. The 2026 classifier change explicitly introduced B with separate matches for two other .b languages. The 1972 and 1973 Bell Labs documents identify the historical language and its two named implementations.

decisions.scope: Supports the row’s language referent, B. The classifier’s C TextMate scope, shared .b suffix and recent specimen libraries supply no platform, vintage, width, or implementation endorsement. The GitHub view, API tree and patch wrapper hashes vary. The immutable pinned row, rule and all three file objects match exactly.
